page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor. It features 54 dedicated vCPUs combined with 480 GB of system memory, providing approximately 8.89 GB of memory per core. Hardware acceleration is delivered by eight dedicated NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units with a total of 128 GB VRAM across all accelerators. The server also includes 3779 GB of local SSD storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

The hardware configuration targets massively parallel computing tasks that demand concurrent multi-GPU execution alongside large memory footprints. Pairing eight physical NVIDIA P100 GPUs with high-capacity local SSD storage allows fast data ingestion directly on the host without relying exclusively on remote network volumes. From an architectural perspective, the resource ratio renders this hardware suitable for deep learning training, parallel scientific calculations, high-performance computing, and video processing workloads.
